items.summary: Implement a second processing pass that runs after initial note cleaning and formatting but before displaying output in the Clean Notes section. This pass should detect bullet points containing more than 10 words with multiple academic action phrases and no commas or conjunctions, then split them into multiple meaningful action-based bullet points based on noun-action sequence patterns.
Apply the action splitting logic only to Convert Paragraph to Points and Definition Style Format modes. Do not apply it to other formatting modes or affect heading detection.

Identify action phrase boundaries using verb changes, noun phrase starts, and functional academic keywords including: helps, removal, distribution, movement, absorption, transport, formation, release, regulation, maintenance. Split each detected action phrase into a separate bullet point while preserving compound scientific terms.
